hermes.goal: Beat buy-and-hold (positive alpha vs BTC) while keeping max drawdown under 15% and never risking the mandate on a single trade — capital preservation first. Near-term: prove a sustained, fee-aware, positive out-of-sample edge on the paper trainer over ~90 days before scaling any live capital; grow the live account only on demonstrated alpha.

brain.commentary: The macro view is a stressed cross‑asset regime with crypto‑centric signals turning negative. The flagship assets (BTC, ETH, SOL, LTC) show flat direction but negative composites and sizable expected shortfalls, indicating downside bias and heightened volatility. The remaining altcoins have flat risk metrics (zero vol/composite) yet are flagged as long with modest conviction – a sign of fragile, data‑poor signals. To preserve capital we tilt down overall exposure and trim conviction modestly across the board, especially on the major cryptos where the downside risk is most evident.
